We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template (template_id 1914385) to the given molecule (initial_molecule SMILES: COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O). The task "make_2_lvl1-apply_template-1" asks to return all possible precursors of applying the template as the result of the task make_2_lvl1-template_search-1 to the molecule below.

We have template ID and mapped_rxn from previous step. We need to apply the template to the molecule to get possible precursors. Use apply_template tool.

We need to provide list of lists of SMILES strings for each possible combination of precursors.

Let's call apply_template with molecule_smiles = given SMILES, template_id = 1914385.
